title: Book as a guest and pay with the airline card
caption: `tools/e2e/specs/storefront/checkout-airline-card.e2e.ts`. Needs `AIRLINE_CARD_ENABLED=true` (default in ota/backend/.env.example) and `airline_card_enabled_test` on (see the local setup flow). No Stripe involved.

steps.title: Start the checkout
steps.body: On a fresh price page press **Continue to checkout** without signing in.

steps.title: Travellers
steps.body: First name `Ada`, last name `Cardtest`, date of birth `1985-04-12` (and whatever else the requirements ask). Continue.
steps.expect: Moves to Contact details only when nothing is missing; otherwise "Travellers saved. Some details are still missing" with the fields marked. DB: `checkout_travelers` rows, `checkouts.version` + 1.

steps.title: Contact and extras
steps.body: E-mail (any address; Mailpit catches it) and a mobile number; Continue; skip extras or pick a bag.
steps.expect: The contact is pre-filled from the first adult. A bag shows the airline's new total and asks to confirm it (`409 PRICE_CHANGED` is expected, not a bug).

steps.title: Choose the airline card
steps.body: Pick **Card, charged by the airline**, read the notice, tick the terms, continue.
steps.expect: `/checkout/pay-airline.html?id=chk_…&payment=pay_…` titled "Pay with your card" with the airline's price (no OTA markup or fees: `checkouts.pricing_mode = 'net'`). DB: `payments` row `provider = 'airline'`, `method = 'airline_card'`.

steps.title: Type the test card and review
steps.body: Holder `Ada Q Holdertest`, number `4111 1111 1111 1111`, an expiry in the future, security code `123`; press **Review the total**.
steps.expect: After six digits the brand is detected and the airline's fee quoted (stub VISA fee €1.20); the button becomes "Pay €…". A number with a wrong check digit (`4111 1111 1111 1112`) is refused on the page and nothing is sent.

steps.title: Pay
steps.expect: "Do not close this page", then `/confirmation.html?booking=bkg_…` with the reference and ticket lines `000-…`. Inputs emptied. DB: `bookings` `ticketed`, `payments` `captured` with `card_brand`, `card_bin` `411111`, `card_last4` `1111` and nothing else of the card. Cookie `__Host-vx_bt` set (httpOnly).

steps.title: E-mails and decline path
steps.body: Check Mailpit. Then try a new booking with the stub's declined card `4000 0000 0000 0002` three times.
steps.expect: "Your booking <reference> with Demo Travel is confirmed" (and the ticketed e-mail). Declines: "The airline declined the card" twice, then "Too many attempts" (`403 PAYMENT_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED`); Redis `t:<tenantId>:test:ac:chk:<checkoutId>` counts 3.
